svg.title: MirbadLLM project structure
svg.desc: The master project MirbadLLM.Web builds on Orchestration and Router, the node agent on NodeRuntime and Pki, and every project ends in the shared Agent.Contracts and Core libraries; tests, deploy, tools and docs folders sit beside src.
